if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/secrets.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "main/secrets.h is missing: copy main/secrets.example.h to main/secrets.h and fill it in.")
endif()

# Includes are written from this folder, e.g. #include "drivers/display.h".
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "main.c"
         # drivers/: the device's hardware
         "drivers/display.c" "drivers/buttons.c" "drivers/buzzer.c" "drivers/leds.c" "drivers/mic.c"
         # gfx/: the software renderer; gfx/assets/ is generated by tools/gen_fonts.py and tools/gen_assets.py
         "gfx/hud.c" "gfx/assets/fonts.c" "gfx/assets/images.c"
         # ui/: the cockpit on the screens, the effects on the LED chain
         "ui/ui.c" "ui/ledfx.c"
         # modes/: the Casio-style modes (tuner, metronome, timer, world clock, ...)
         "modes/modes.c" "modes/mode_music.c" "modes/mode_time.c" "modes/mode_fx.c"
         # net/: the stats agents, weather and time, the web API, the mic stream
         "net/netdata.c" "net/web.c" "net/stream.c"
         # core/: settings, low power, alerts, time zones
         "core/settings.c" "core/power.c" "core/alerts.c" "core/tzlite.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    EMBED_FILES "web/index.html.gz"     # built by webui/build.mjs
    REQUIRES esp_wifi esp_netif esp_event esp_http_server esp_http_client app_update esp_partition
             esp_app_format esp_timer esp_lcd esp_driver_gpio esp_driver_ledc esp_driver_i2s esp_driver_rmt esp_adc
             nvs_flash json mbedtls esp_pm
)
